bass.name: Bass
bass.description: A common freshwater fish found in most lakes and rivers.
bass.personality: Lazy and slow-moving, prefers shallow waters.

trout.name: Trout
trout.description: A common freshwater fish known for its fighting spirit.
trout.personality: Energetic and quick, loves cold mountain streams.

perch.name: Perch
perch.description: A common freshwater fish with distinctive stripes.
perch.personality: Curious and social, often found in schools.

pike.name: Pike
pike.description: An uncommon predatory fish with sharp teeth.
pike.personality: Aggressive hunter, lurks in weedy areas waiting for prey.

salmon.name: Salmon
salmon.description: An uncommon fish known for its upstream migrations.
salmon.personality: Determined and strong, never gives up on its journey.

sturgeon.name: Sturgeon
sturgeon.description: A rare ancient fish, prized for its caviar.
sturgeon.personality: Ancient and wise, has seen centuries pass by.

marlin.name: Marlin
marlin.description: A rare deep-sea fish with a distinctive spear-like bill.
marlin.personality: Proud and majestic, considers itself the king of the sea.

golden_trout.name: Golden Trout
golden_trout.description: An epic fish with shimmering golden scales.
golden_trout.personality: Vain and beautiful, loves to show off its golden shimmer.

giant_squid.name: Giant Squid
giant_squid.description: An epic deep-sea creature with massive tentacles.
giant_squid.personality: Mysterious and intelligent, guardian of the deep abyss.

dragon_fish.name: Dragon Fish
dragon_fish.description: A legendary fish with dragon-like scales and fierce eyes.
dragon_fish.personality: Fierce and proud, breathes underwater fire and commands respect.

phoenix_salmon.name: Phoenix Salmon
phoenix_salmon.description: A legendary fish that glows with inner fire.
phoenix_salmon.personality: Reborn from the ashes of defeat, never truly dies.

stardust_fish.name: Stardust Fish
stardust_fish.description: A galactic fish made of pure stardust and cosmic energy.
stardust_fish.personality: Dreamy and ethereal, swims through both water and space.

nebula_whale.name: Nebula Whale
nebula_whale.description: A galactic whale-like creature containing entire star systems.
nebula_whale.personality: Ancient cosmic entity, sings songs that create new stars.

void_leviathan.name: Void Leviathan
void_leviathan.description: An intergalactic sea monster from the depths of space.
void_leviathan.personality: Destroyer of worlds, feeds on the fear of lesser beings.

quantum_fish.name: Quantum Fish
quantum_fish.description: An intergalactic fish that exists in multiple dimensions.
quantum_fish.personality: Exists everywhere and nowhere, defies all logic.

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.description: A godlike sea monster of immense power and size.
kraken.personality: Ruler of all seas, awakens only when the ocean is threatened.

leviathan.name: Leviathan
leviathan.description: A godlike primordial sea beast from ancient times.
leviathan.personality: Primordial chaos incarnate, remembers the birth of oceans.

world_turtle.name: World Turtle
world_turtle.description: A mythical turtle carrying entire worlds on its shell.
world_turtle.personality: Patient and wise, carries the weight of civilizations.

cosmic_serpent.name: Cosmic Serpent
cosmic_serpent.description: A mythical serpent that wraps around galaxies.
cosmic_serpent.personality: Eternal guardian of cosmic balance, keeper of universal secrets.

reality_fish.name: Reality Fish
reality_fish.description: An impossible fish that bends the laws of existence.
reality_fish.personality: Transcends reality itself, exists beyond mortal comprehension.

the_first_fish.name: The First Fish
the_first_fish.description: The otherworldly ancestor of all fish, the beginning of aquatic life.
the_first_fish.personality: The original consciousness, from which all water life emerged.

christmas_fish.name: Christmas Fish
christmas_fish.description: A festive fish that only appears during Christmas season.
christmas_fish.personality: Jolly and generous, spreads holiday cheer wherever it swims.

halloween_fish.name: Halloween Fish
halloween_fish.description: A spooky fish that only appears during Halloween season.
halloween_fish.personality: Mischievous and spooky, loves to play pranks on other fish.

new_year_fish.name: New Year Fish
new_year_fish.description: A celebratory fish that only appears during New Year season.
new_year_fish.personality: Optimistic and hopeful, believes every cast is a new beginning.

anniversary_fish.name: Anniversary Fish
anniversary_fish.description: A special fish that only appears during bot anniversary.
anniversary_fish.personality: Nostalgic and grateful, remembers every milestone of the bot.
